needs-listed.quote: What each one needs on your machine; every Python 3 below means Python 3.9 or later, the version macOS ships:

items.quote: **owner**: the person who asks the sessions for work and answers their questions
**manager**: the one Claude session per project that writes down what the owner asks for as a GitHub issue
**worker**: a Claude session that takes one issue from the manager, splits it into tasks
**sentinel**: a light Claude session that the manager starts for one endless duty
**judge**: a new Claude helper that did not write the work and only reviews it
